chunks: In order that He may cut off a part of the unbelievers or overpower them, so they return in frustration.

key_terms.فَيَنْقَلِبُوا: so they return or turn back

ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of cutting off the disbelievers according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dual objectives of jihad: either to physically weaken the enemy's capacity or to crush their pride (kibt), thereby forcing a return to their communities in a state of humiliation. This reflects the strategic wisdom of divine action, ensuring that the disbelievers' efforts yield no lasting glory or success.
